text.en:
1. This order may be cited as the Bankers' Books (Evidence) Ordinance citation ana
(Extension) Order, 1971, and shall come into force on the first day of commence:
May, 1971.

2. The Bankers' Books (Evidence) Ordinance, 1949, shall have effect Modification
with the modifications set out in the Schedule to this Order, and as 4B,
so modified is hereby extended to Sabah and Sarawak.

3. The Bankers' Books Evidence Ordinance of Sabah and the Bankers'
Books (Evidence) Ordinance of Sarawak are hereby repealed.

SCHEDULE
(Article 2)

MODIFICATIONS TO BE MADE TO THE BANKERS' BOOKS (EVIDENCE)
ORDINANCE, 1949

Section                                                          Modification

2, definition of Substitute the following:

"bank" and      "'bank' and ‘banker' mean any company carrying on

banker       the business of banking in Malaysia incorporated by or
under any Written law in force in Malaysia and any
company carrying on such business in Malaysia under a
licence granted under any written law in force in Malaysia
relating to banking, and also any Post Office Savings Bank
established in Malaysia;".

2, definition of Substitute the following:

"Court"           "‘Court? means the High Court and in connection with
any proceedings before a Scssions Court or, in the States
of Sabah and Sarawak, before the Court of a Magistrate of
the First Class, includes such Court;".

Made this 17th day of November, 1970.
[P.N. 3375 /183.]

By Command,

TAN SRI ABDUL KADIR BIN SHAMSUDDIN,
Secretary to the Cabinet

(To be laid before each House of Parliament pursuant to section 74 (9)
of the Malaysia Act.)

P.U. (A) 96.

ORDINAN KAWASAN LARANGAN DAN TEMPAT
LARANGAN, 1959

atas keselamatan dalam negeri dengan ini membuat perentah yang
berikut :

1. Perentah ini boleh-lah di-namakan Perentah Tempat? Larangan,

2. Kawasan yang di-nyatakan dalam Jadual bersama ini ada-lah dengan
ini di-ishtiharkan menjadi tempat? larangan.
